points.description: States that the height is a path length (the length of a path), not merely the number of nodes in the tree. Equivalent wording such as 'distance' or 'number of steps along a path' is acceptable.
States that the path considered starts at the root of the tree.
States that the path considered ends at a leaf (a node with no children).
States that the height is the longest (maximum) such root-to-leaf path. An answer that says shortest path, or any path without taking the maximum, earns no marks for this point.

rubric.notes: Full marks require all four elements: height is a path length, the path starts at the root, the path ends at a leaf, and it is the longest such path. Award each point independently; equivalent wording is acceptable. No marks for P4 if the answer does not identify the longest/maximum root-to-leaf path.
